identity.policy: Declared DP83826I plus both successfully read words, expected OUI, selected mode and explicitly accepted revision. Revision 1 is documented; unknown revisions require evidence before managed configuration. Do not infer I/E or A-generation suffix from shared model fields. All-zero/all-one observations are plausibility failures, not proof of absent hardware.

procedures.restoration: No configuration mutation; reset/external writes invalidate prior epochs and require reacquisition.

gates.conflict: BMCR allows forced speed/duplex but PHYSTS says ENHANCED AN-disabled speed/duplex bits both1; BASIC says strap-latched.
gates.decision: Keep configured BMCR mode separate from independently resolved link. Do not publish PHYSTS as universally resolved forced mode.
gates.nextEvidence: Exact-part TI correction or identified BASIC/ENHANCED traces covering software-forced10/100 half/full; coordinate prompts6,18,19,39.

gates.conflict: 8.4.1 says software resets reload stored straps; PHYRCR hard reset says same as reset pin. Physical resampling scope for software hard reset is ambiguous.
gates.decision: Pin reset resamples eligible straps; ENHANCED1/6 POR-only. Do not claim software hard-reset physically resamples pins. Re-read identity/address/straps after reset and retain uncertainty.
gates.nextEvidence: Exact-part TI clarification or authorized strap-change measurement distinguishing pin reset, PHYRCR hard reset and PCS reset.

gates.conflict: BMCR resets PCS registers but exact complete register-by-register PCS domain not enumerated.
gates.decision: Preserve vendor state as specified; invalidate/reverify owned standard control/advertisement/next-page state. Do not assert address range defines PCS domain.
gates.nextEvidence: Exact reset-domain clarification or identified readbacks; conservative replay of owned stable standard settings remains safe.

gates.conflict: VOD_CFG3 top nibble marked R while required4A40 recipe changes it from8 to4.
gates.decision: Allow exact mandatory full-word recipe only, no arbitrary top-nibble tuning. Stable recipe readback mismatch remains failure, never silently accept.
gates.nextEvidence: TI exact-part clarification or qualified trace for generic tuning semantics.

gates.conflict: Printed MMD3 1001/1014/1016 and MMD7 203C/203D do not establish normalized on-wire offsets; vendor recipe extends beyond REGCR prose04D1 ceiling.
gates.decision: Keep printed tuples apart from wire tuples; recipe addresses only exact-source future allowlist, no broad range.
gates.nextEvidence: Exact DP83826I TI access trace/clarification and full recipe audit, including values above04D1.

gates.conflict: TI field tables expose next-page controls/events but do not completely specify management load/event ordering. IEEE restart clears page-loaded state and initial page event is BASE, so pre-restart loading plus treating every event as NEXT is not justified.
gates.decision: Use selected phase-separated IEEE sequence as normative comparison. Gate custom exchange implementation until exact-part load acceptance, receive retention and event distinction are established. Preserve raw page observations and ordinary AN independently.
